description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/godunov_norm_D2_periodic driven by problems/godunov_norm_2d_eikonal_mms.esm, loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding of NX=NY together (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4). Forced-steady eikonal u_t = -S*godunov(u) + S|grad g| with exact solution g = sin(2 pi x) + sin(2 pi y); the discretization error is the first-order Godunov truncation S*(|grad g| - godunov(g)) = O(dx + dy). The manufactured |grad g| = 2 pi sqrt(cos^2(2 pi x) + cos^2(2 pi y)) has slope-sign kinks in each gradient component, but the Rouy-Tourin/Osher-Sethian entropy fix keeps the scheme first-order in L2 AND Linf uniformly, so both norms fall as O(h) (expected order 1).

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

blocked_upstream_bindings.rust: Rust hangs at every tolerance tried (loosest reltol 1e-6; all three solvers Erk/Bdf/Sdirk wedge). earthsci-toolkit-rs's diffsol integrator has no dtmin/max-step fail-fast guard, so on this stiff / non-smooth-min-max / large-AST RHS it drives dt->0 without terminating instead of erroring. Julia (Tsit5) and Python (LSODA) solve it. Remove once the Rust solver gains a step guard.
